body:
Upstream CI tool releases currently fail unrelated pull requests throughout Dependabot's seven-day cooldown. The checker now warns about outdated versions on every event, while invalid references, SHA/tag mismatches, image/asset checksum mismatches, and lookup failures still fail.

Fixes #22

- **9a — freshness:** use the issue's warning-only option; keep annotations, the step summary, scheduled checks, and Dependabot's cooldown. No manual dependency bump is needed to unblock an unrelated PR.
- **9b — SHA pins:** accept `owner/repo[/subpath]@<40-hex-sha> # vX.Y.Z`, including quoted references. Resolve the commented tag through `gh api repos/<repo>/commits/<tag>` and compare its commit SHA, caching by repository and version. Missing/invalid version comments and mismatched or unresolvable tags fail. Existing version pins and Bun runtime requirements remain supported.
- **9c — downloads:** add `--retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 --connect-timeout 20` to the existing three retries, retaining checksum verification before execution.
- **5 — file sizes:** recursively check `.java`, `.mjs`, and `.js`; warn at 900–1000 lines and fail above 1000. Preserve generated-directory exclusions and `--max-lines`. Count a trailing newline correctly, and escape filenames in warning annotations.

Contributor documentation describes the policies. A patch changeset prepares the existing automated release process.

### Reproduction and automated verification

- The original Workflow Policy run [43401490353](https://github.com/link-foundation/java-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43401490353) failed on stale setup-java, create-pull-request, and OSV versions (downloaded log lines 379–387). These are warnings with this change.
- `experiments/ci-dependencies.test.mjs`: stale releases warn across PR/push/scheduled/manual events, SHA pins parse correctly, tags match the pinned commit, repeated lookups are cached, and CLI lookup errors/mismatches fail closed. All upstream responses are mocked.
- `experiments/osv-download.test.mjs`: execute the real OSV installation block against a local HTTP server that ends the first response mid-transfer (curl error 18). The retry downloads the complete file and passes SHA-256 verification. The test and child process have finite limits.
- `experiments/file-size.test.mjs`: each extension at 899/900/999/1000/1001 lines, generated-directory exclusions, custom limits, unterminated final lines, and annotation escaping.
- `scripts/workflow-policy.test.mjs`: retain workflow policies and require the resilient curl flags.

Before implementation, 23 of the initial 67 focused tests failed against the original code. After implementation, `node --test scripts/*.test.mjs experiments/*.test.mjs` passed **104/104**, including the additional CLI and interrupted-transfer tests. `node scripts/check-file-size.mjs` passed for all 30 source files; `git diff --check` passed. Full Java builds, Actionlint, and live dependency/security lookups run in existing CI.

### Final CI evidence

All workflows passed for final commit `434e6da353005024c7e15d90dea735b4a9fb341e`:

- [CI/CD Pipeline](https://github.com/link-foundation/java-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43402138920): Java 21 tests on Ubuntu 24.04, Windows 2025, and macOS 26; package build and artifact upload; changeset validation; formatting, script regressions, and Actionlint.
- [Workflow Policy](https://github.com/link-foundation/java-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43402139140): regression tests and live upstream lookups passed, with the stale versions recorded as warnings (log lines 457–465).
- [Security](https://github.com/link-foundation/java-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43402138956): OSV dependency and Maven plugin audits passed.

The branch includes current `main`; the working tree is clean. All four issue requirements are implemented and verified, with no deferred work.
